_about: Giant monsters, the machines and pilots built to meet them, and the city in between. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

monster: a coral-backed titan that rises from the trench
a winged thing that blots out the sun
a swarm that joins into one giant body
a crab the size of a cathedral
a naga of the river, woken by dredging
a burning beast that walks out of a volcano
a creature made of the city's own rubble
something that looks like it is grieving
why_it_comes: it is following a signal nobody knew was sent
its nest was destroyed by a deep-sea mine
it hunts the reactor that powers the city
it is fleeing something even larger
it comes back to the same bay every hundred years
a cult has been calling it with drums
it wants its stolen egg back
it is dying and looking for a place to rest
defense: a walking machine piloted by two linked minds
a rail cannon on the harbour wall
an old temple ritual the monks still remember
a fleet of patched-together salvage mechs
a weapon made from the bones of the last one
a chemical that makes the sea taste wrong to it
a song that soothes it, if anyone can sing it
a prototype machine nobody has finished testing
city: a coastal megacity rebuilt behind a giant wall
bangkok's canals, flooded and full of boats
a fishing town with one great sea wall
a floating city anchored in a typhoon belt
a mountain capital the monsters never reached until now
a harbour of shipyards that build the machines
a refugee city made of shipping containers
an island nation running out of places to retreat
cost: every launch burns the pilot's memories
the machines run on a fuel that poisons the bay
the funding comes from a company with a secret
the only working pilot is a frightened teenager
the monster's blood turns the ground barren
a link between pilots that never fully closes
the government lies about how many died
people_below: a street food vendor who will not leave her cart
a school bus stuck on a collapsing bridge
a salvage crew who sells monster parts
a reporter filming everything from the rooftops
a hospital that cannot evacuate in time
a pilot's family in the evacuation zone
a cult that wants to be eaten
monks who refuse to leave the riverside temple

1: a tremor on the instruments and a shadow in the sea
the beaches close and nobody says why
2: a district falls while the city watches
3: the machine is broken and the next one is not ready
4: the final stand at the city's heart
the monster's purpose is understood, too late or just in time

cliches: the monster is just nature striking back
the scientist nobody believed was right
the hothead pilot and the by-the-book commander
the giant robot gets a sword at the last moment
